clauses: Average equipment-level humidities equally to get the all-equipment average.
Pool all nonmissing humidity readings to get the all-equipment average.
readings: Among equipment whose average relative humidity (`scanenvironment.humepct`, ignoring missing readings) is above the average across all equipment, which are the top 10 by how far they sit above the mean of that above-average group? Show the equipment reference, its average humidity, how much it exceeds the all-equipment average, and its difference from the group mean. Return nothing if either reference average is missing, and sort from highest to lowest with missing values last. Average equipment-level humidities equally to get the all-equipment average.

Among equipment whose average relative humidity (`scanenvironment.humepct`, ignoring missing readings) is above the average across all equipment, which are the top 10 by how far they sit above the mean of that above-average group? Show the equipment reference, its average humidity, how much it exceeds the all-equipment average, and its difference from the group mean. Return nothing if either reference average is missing, and sort from highest to lowest with missing values last. Pool all nonmissing humidity readings to get the all-equipment average.
queries:
WITH equipment_humidity AS (
    SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
    GROUP BY equipref
),
all_equipment AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS overall_avg
    FROM equipment_humidity
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity, a.overall_avg
    FROM equipment_humidity AS e
    CROSS JOIN all_equipment AS a
    WHERE e.avg_humidity > a.overall_avg
),
group_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS group_avg
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT
    a.equipref,
    a.avg_humidity,
    a.avg_humidity - a.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg,
    a.avg_humidity - g.group_avg AS difference_from_group_mean
FROM above_average AS a
CROSS JOIN group_average AS g
WHERE a.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND g.group_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH equipment_averages AS (
    SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
    GROUP BY equipref
),
all_equipment_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity, a.avg_humidity AS overall_average
    FROM equipment_averages AS e
    CROSS JOIN all_equipment_average AS a
    WHERE e.avg_humidity > a.avg_humidity
),
group_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS avg_humidity
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT
    e.equipref,
    e.avg_humidity,
    e.avg_humidity - e.overall_average AS exceeds_all_equipment_average,
    e.avg_humidity - g.avg_humidity AS difference_from_group_mean
FROM above_average AS e
CROSS JOIN group_average AS g
WHERE e.overall_average IS NOT NULL
  AND g.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
